code:
import boto3

ec2 = boto3.client("ec2", region_name="us-east-1")

response = ec2.describe_volumes(
    Filters=[{"Name": "status", "Values": ["available"]}]
)

for volume in response["Volumes"]:
    print(volume["VolumeId"], volume["Size"], volume["CreateTime"])
